summary: A county chooses someone to speak for its readers on a board shared with neighboring counties.
realLife: County executives nominated trustees for Wisconsin's South Central Library System, and county supervisory boards ratified the choices in a system serving independently governed libraries.
inGame: needs: member libraries and appointing county.

turns.pulledBy: A county has ratified its nominee.
turns.what: The trustee takes a regional seat.
turns.writesBack: The county has a representative at the next meeting.

turns.pulledBy: The matter concerns only a member library's own policy.
turns.what: The trustee refers the resident to its local board.
turns.writesBack: The local board receives the request.
